                        │    b              Link dependency (blocked by)   │
                        │    B              Unlink dependency              │
                        │    T              Dependency browser (map +      │
                        │  tree)                                           │
                        │    m              Move/reorder item              │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    Reading an item                               │
                        │    space e n t x  Act on the item shown,         │
                        │    p b B T        as on its row                  │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    On a task row                                 │
                        │    space          Toggle task done               │
                        │    d              Delete task                    │
                        │    t              Add a sibling task             │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    Global                                        │
                        │    u              Undo last action               │
                        │    /              Search                         │
                        │    1              Filter: blocked only (toggle)  │
                        │    2              Filter: all + archived         │
                        │  (toggle)                                        │
                        │    0              Filter: reset                  │
                        │    R              Sync now (runs automatically   │
                        │  too)                                            │
                        │    q  Ctrl+C      Quit                           │
                        │    ?              Toggle this help               │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    [Esc] or [?] Close                            │
                        │                                                  │
                        ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
